```python
gelu_tanh(x: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray
```

Part of [`evoxc_hf.reference`](/api/evoxc-hf/reference/)

Tanh-approximated GELU — HF `gelu_new` / `gelu_pytorch_tanh`.

`0.5 * x * (1 + tanh(sqrt(2/pi) * (x + 0.044715 * x**3)))`, the formula in
`transformers.activations.NewGELUActivation` (which GPT-2 uses).

## Parameters

- `x` · `np.ndarray` — Real array of any shape.

## Returns

- `np.ndarray` — `float32` array with `x.shape`.  `float64` input is downcast.
